title: 正派の正体、見せてやる
reward: 奪われた記録と三人の協力

scenes.name: 正義の命令
scenes.purpose: 敵の立場と制度の矛盾を具体化する

panels.art: Daybreak town square. Yun, So Rin and Hakujin at street edge, sword sheathed bronze disk at sash. Alliance guards blue-white robes form a cordon, long pole weapons aimed outward. No battle yet.
panels.speaker: 盟の使者
panels.text: 天魔と、その仲間を捕らえよ！

panels.art: A worried middle-aged town mother shields adult son while guards point to Hakujin's white hair, Yun looks at frightened townspeople.
panels.speaker: 町の母
panels.text: その人が、うちの子を助けたのに。

panels.art: Yun looks at angry guards and innocent crowd, palm open to deescalate.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: ここで戦ったら、町が壊れる。

panels.art: Smith So Rin taps a small BRONZE memory prism taken from her apron pocket, firm eyes. Prism non-glowing for now, right wrist free.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン
panels.text: 宝庫の記録なら、私が持ってる。

scenes.name: 奪った歴史
scenes.purpose: 言葉だけでなく記録を示す

panels.art: Close So Rin sets bronze prism into slot in town memorial pedestal, Yun protects crowd with raised LEFT palm and cyan barrier. Sword sheathed.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン
panels.text: 鍛冶の道具は、嘘を刻まない。

panels.art: Prism projects translucent moving images ABOVE square: alliance soldiers carrying gold from underground treasury, adult craftsmen taken into prison. No text, no illegible pages, original sober memory shot.
panels.speaker: 町の母
panels.text: これが、正派のしたこと？

panels.art: Hakujin steps forward in front of projection, RIGHT wrist bare, gold eyes steady and grieving, townspeople listen.
panels.speaker: 白燼
panels.text: 俺の殺意も、命令だった。

panels.art: One young guard lowers spear, conflict visible on face. Yun opens empty RIGHT hand offering surrender, sword stays sheathed.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 確かめてから、選んでくれ。

scenes.name: 書き直される町
scenes.purpose: 味方を増やす報酬と補正の不穏さ

panels.art: Some guards lower weapons and make room; mother places a bowl of hot tea in Yun's hands, he accepts with surprise. Smith and white-haired ally share quiet relief.
panels.speaker: 町の母

panels.art: Yun sits at modest tea stall with companions, holding bowl two hands. Human warmth, no grand throne.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン
panels.text: 画面の名前だけじゃ、なかった。

panels.art: Sudden cyan translucent hologram visible only to Yun, text exactly two horizontal lines: シナリオ逸脱 / 補正開始. He freezes, bowl placed safely on table.
panels.speaker: システム
panels.text: シナリオ逸脱　補正開始

panels.art: Town street at dusk, several adult guards' eyes become blank and thin BLACK bands wrap wrists, mother protected behind stall. Yun stands alarmed. Do not show ensuing fight or arena reward shields yet.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

scenes.name: 記録の重さ
scenes.purpose: 記録を見せる前に読み合わせ、ソ・リン自身が公に証言する意思を選ぶ

panels.art: Town square side: So Rin spreads an old metal plate and its corresponding ledger on a low table. Yun with sword SHEATHED reads, Hakujin stands quietly nearby, RIGHT wrist clean.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: So Rin points to the repeated maker's stamp engraved on ONE plate, no invented readable background letters. She recognizes her own work.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン

panels.art: Yun pauses, looks from plate to So Rin, does not pull her forward. Tense crowd stays behind them; no attack.
panels.speaker: ハン・ユン

panels.art: So Rin takes the plate into her own hands and chooses to step toward the waiting town mother. Yun supports beside her, no public reveal of marks yet.
panels.speaker: ソ・リン
